name: ecommerce-materiais-construcao
description: Plataforma de e-commerce para materiais de construção

scripts.deploy:build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend-nestjs
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend-nestjs" "npm run dev:ia"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend-nestjs
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ../backend-nestjs && npm install && cd ../ia && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && cp .env.example .env && cp frontend/.env.example frontend/.env.local && cp backend/.env.example backend/.env && cp backend-nestjs/.env.example backend-nestjs/.env && cp ia/.env.example ia/.env
scripts.db:push: cd backend-nestjs && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend-nestjs && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd backend-nestjs && npx prisma db seed

author: Equipe de Desenvolvimento
